reason: Not a legacy-format question: it concerns pack capture of filesystem sources that change during capture (retry count, Unix-vs-Windows stability predicate, abort/exclude/record disposition, snapshot integration). Its program-section 25 tag does not make any legacy import, export or adapter measurement informative for its candidates; the nearest legacy analogue (a legacy archive rewritten while convert or sidecar reads it) would not select among the pack candidates.
evidence_route: Capture/platform domain experiment implementing objective MVT-07(d): seeded mutator (rewrite, truncate, extend, rename-over, touch mtime) against ebound pack on NTFS (Windows host) and ext4 (WSL), FAT via a loop image, SMB only if an owner-provided share exists; plus the static by-path re-open audit of the capture code and a snapshot-API availability survey without unsafe code or admin rights (program section 21).
